purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for mutation definitions/executions, semantic diffs, transactions, conflicts, revisions, deletes and resulting provenance.

owns: DWH Write and Transaction Monitor semantics

topics.name: DWH Write and Transaction Monitor
topics.purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for mutation definitions/executions, semantic diffs, transactions, conflicts, revisions, deletes and resulting provenance.

semantics.identity_rule: Operation, write execution, transaction, target record, revision and Event identities remain distinct.
semantics.diff_rule: UI distinguishes before/candidate/accepted values without treating candidate as committed.
semantics.action_rule: apply/retry/reconcile/rollback/delete operations invoke separate authorized canonical workflows.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing a mutation/conflict grants no write/reconciliation authority.
semantics.graph_rule: Transaction/dependency/relation edges correspond only to explicit refs.
semantics.failure_rule: Partial commit, stale revision, denied write and failed delete are shown explicitly.

invariants.rule: Every DWH mutation resolves an exact destination instance/schema/record/field identity, validates intended change, evaluates authorization and conflict state, and records provenance; no write is inferred from query/display context or silently overwrites conflicting accepted state.

hard_gates.condition: monitor displays candidate patch as committed

prose.summary: Define a read-only Expose monitor for mutation definitions/executions, semantic diffs, transactions, conflicts, revisions, deletes and resulting provenance.
notes: Unlocked pending reconciliation against DWH schema binding, lineage, AccessCore and canonical change-boundary contracts.
